value.option_title: Motif calls emitted for Capsida NR001–NR005 and Lir Starfish binding-assay readouts
value.question: Can computed capsid–receptor binding calls for ALPL, AAVR and LRP6 reproduce published bind/no-bind readouts with interfaces at the threefold axis?
value.hypothesis: Pairs that bind in plate- and bead-based assays share threefold-axis or insert-loop engagement geometry, so pose enumeration recovers published bind/no-bind labels [s_aavr_struct].

compute_axis.quantity: Independent capsid–receptor model runs (docking, AlphaFold-Multimer, MD relaxation) the answer needs

held_fixed: Public capsid sequences (AAV2, AAV5, AAV9, AAV9-X1.1, AAV.CAP-Mac, AAV-PHP.eB) and human receptor ectodomain constructs
Docking box, scoring function and 4.5 A contact cutoff
MD protocol: 5 ns explicit-solvent relaxation of top poses, one force field and water model
Bind-call threshold and site rule: interface within 5 A RMSD or >=50% contact overlap of the published site
Published bind/no-bind labels for the 13 reference pairs
GPU type for the main grid: 8x NVIDIA A100 SXM 40 GB

predictions.if_lever: Balanced accuracy 0.80 at 432 runs versus 0.55 at 54, with five of six known binders within 5 Å of published sites.
predictions.if_not: Accuracy moves under 0.05 between 54 and 432 runs and at most three of six binders reach published sites; extra runs resample the wrong basin.
predictions.decision_rule: Call if_lever iff balanced accuracy at 432 runs minus balanced accuracy at 54 runs is >= 0.10 and >= 5 of 6 reference positives have top poses inside the site tolerance; otherwise if_not.
predictions.noise_rule: Three independent seed sets per run level, mean and SD reported; a gap counts only if it exceeds 2x the SD across seed sets and a paired permutation test over the 13 labels gives p < 0.05.
predictions.expected_why: Binding calls hinge on insert loops already visible in sequence space, so pose depth saturates quickly; receptor flexibility, not run count, limits site agreement.

value.compute_tested_why: Levels 54, 216 and 432 vary exactly the pose-and-seed model runs that more parallel GPUs buy across the capsid by receptor grid; sequences, labels and protocols stay fixed.
value.scored_against: Published bind/no-bind labels for 13 reference pairs (SPR, pull-down, cell microarray) and published interface sites: AAV2–AAVR threefold-adjacent footprint (PDB 6IHB), LRP6 E1E2 preference over E3E4, and the AAV9-versus-LY6A negative.

arms.what: Full 6x6 capsid–receptor grid at 216 model runs: one docking job, three AlphaFold-Multimer seeds and two 5-ns MD relaxations per pair
3x3 subset at 54 runs measuring throughputs and seed-to-seed noise before the main spend
Score-only baseline: rigid-body docking ranking without multimer models or the threefold geometry filter
Serial one-GPU execution of the same 54 pilot runs, timed for wall-clock and checked for result equivalence
Stretch arm at 432 runs: six AlphaFold-Multimer seeds and four MD relaxations per pair

baseline.what: Rigid-body docking score ranking alone, no multimer model and no threefold geometry filter, on the same 36-pair grid
baseline.value: balanced accuracy on the 13 published labels, measured in phase p2_main

anchor.what: Redocking AAVR-PKD2 onto AAV2 must place it beside the threefold spike matching PDB 6IHB contacts; serial and parallel pilots must match calls.
anchor.published_value: PKD2 bound to the AAV2 spike region adjacent to the icosahedral three-fold axis (PDB 6IHB)
anchor.tolerance: >=50% contact overlap at the published 4.5 Å cutoff or interface backbone RMSD <=5 Å; serial versus parallel top-pose RMSD <=2 Å with identical bind/no-bind calls
anchor.independent_code: LightDock and pyDock both run the anchor pair; a consensus pose is required before phase p2_main

checks: Anchor redock: best AAV2–AAVR-PKD2 pose recovers the 6IHB threefold-adjacent footprint with >=50% contact overlap at 4.5 Å.
Domain check: X1 and CAP-Mac VR-VIII peptide models select LRP6 E1E2 over E3E4 [s_shay_af].
Negative controls called no-bind: AAV9xLRP6, AAV9xLY6A, AAV9-X1.1xLRP5, AAV9xALPL [s_shay_lrp5, s_ly6a, s_alpl].
Serial versus parallel pilot: identical bind/no-bind calls and top-pose interface RMSD <=2 Å.
Seed noise: three seed sets per level; report mean ± SD; decision gaps must exceed 2x SD.
Budget: total_stated <= budget_usd; hard stop at spend_cap_usd = 1000.

phases.what: Install ColabFold, GROMACS and LightDock; fetch capsid and receptor structures and sequences (PDB 6IHB, 1LP3, AAV9 and PHP.eB capsids, ALPL, AAVR PKD1/PKD2, LRP6 E1E2/E3E4, LRP5, LY6A); assemble AAV9-X1.1 and CAP-Mac from Shay 2024 Table 1; run the anchor redock and the LRP6 domain check.

gate.else: retune the docking box or switch pose generation to AlphaFold-Multimer only before the main spend

phases.what: Run the 54-run pilot (3 capsids x 3 receptors) on 8x A100 and measure af2_h_per_run, md_ns_per_day_a100, aux_h_per_pair and seed-to-seed SD of calls.

gate.else: take the docking-plus-MD fallback line with one AlphaFold-Multimer seed per pair, or move the grid to 12 pairs

phases.what: Run the 216-run main grid on 8x A100; emit the plate-layout call table and bead-panel CSV with bind/no-bind, score, interface residues, distance to nearest threefold axis and site class.
phases.stop_rule: 24-hour timer or all 216 runs complete; hard stop at spend_cap_usd

phases.what: Score balanced accuracy and site recovery at nested run levels 54/216/432 by subsampling runs; rank binding-positive pairs; write the ranked candidate list and the serial-versus-parallel comparison.
Optional: expand to 432 runs (six AlphaFold-Multimer seeds, four MD relaxations per pair) and re-score.

gate.else: skip the stretch arm; report the 216-run level only

restructuring.sequential_part: No answer waits on another: 216 independent runs; three stages follow one another only within each run.
restructuring.baseline_sequential: One A100 runs the 54 pilot jobs back to back as a serial queue with batch size 1 and the same seeds; timed for wall-clock and result identity
restructuring.baseline_copies: Eight independent one-GPU copies of the same jobs on one 8-GPU node with identical per-run settings; timed for wall-clock

scope_gap: Cannot test transcytosis or any post-binding fate; the observable is binding agreement plus interface geometry only.
Cannot use Capsida NR001–NR005 or Lir Starfish sequences and assay outputs; public bind/no-bind labels cover 13 of 36 pairs.
5-ns MD relaxes local geometry; it does not deliver affinities or equilibrium occupancies.
NR001–NR005 receptors beyond ALPL, AAVR and LRP6 are unnamed publicly, so the receptor set is the published BBB panel plus controls.

novelty.closest_prior: Shay et al. 2024 used five AlphaFold-Multimer models per peptide and cryo-ET to map LRP6 and IL3 binding on engineered capsids, with SPR labels [s_shay_af].
novelty.left_open: Whether hundreds of pose and seed runs improve bind/no-bind agreement with threefold-axis geometry across a full capsid-by-receptor grid remains untested [s_shay_af].

limits: Binding-call agreement and interface geometry only; no transcytosis or affinity.
Public labels cover 13 of 36 pairs; NR001–NR005 and Starfish assays are proprietary.
value.test_summary: Thirty-six capsid–receptor pairs run docking, three AlphaFold-Multimer seeds, two 5-ns MD relaxations; calls and threefold-site geometry scored on published labels; parallel wall-clock versus serial one-GPU and independent-copy baselines.

sources.quote: Plan NVIDIA A100 SXM | VRAM/GPU: 40 GB | vCPUs: 124 | RAM: 1800 GiB | STORAGE: 5.8 TiB SSD | PRICE/GPU/HR*: $1.99 (* plus applicable sales tax/VAT/GST)
sources.supports: Per-GPU hourly prices for A100, H100 and A6000 instances and the $0.20 per GiB-month filesystem rate used in the cost lines.

sources.quote: The predictive power of in vitro receptor binding is confirmed by AAV transduction in cell lines with receptor expression
sources.supports: Capsida NR001–NR005 platform uses in vitro receptor binding readouts, emitted in plate-based and bead-based detection formats ('Plate-Based Receptor Binding Detection Bead-Based Receptor Binding Detection'), the output format this plan reproduces.

sources.quote: We have identified novel human blood-brain barrier receptors that bind our engineered capsids and are conserved between primates and humans.
sources.supports: Capsida's platform binds engineered capsids to novel human BBB receptors, the setting the option targets.

sources.quote: portions of the surface such as at the 2, 3 and 5-fold axes are the minimum subunit for useful docking or structural assessment of capsid stability in silico.
sources.supports: Lir's Starfish pipeline docks receptor targets to capsid multimer surfaces built at the symmetry axes; also reports 3-fold AAV9 axes within RMSD <1 A, Boltz2 OOM on an 80 GB H100 at the 5-fold axis, and LY6A docking screens.

sources.quote: Both AAV9-X1.1 and CAP-Mac strongly bind human LRP6-Fc, unlike their parent capsid, AAV9, with a sub-nM apparent affinity.
sources.supports: Published bind/no-bind labels for AAV9-X1.1, CAP-Mac and AAV9 against LRP6, and the LRP6 receptor in the panel.

sources.quote: Representative AlphaFold models, from 5 structural models each of X1 and CAP-Mac peptides with up to 20 recycles, predict selective interaction with human LRP6 domain E1 (E1 and E2: teal, E3 and E4: yellow, AAV peptides: purple).
sources.supports: Closest prior compute quantity (AlphaFold model count and recycle depth) and the E1E2-versus-E3E4 domain check used as an anchor.

sources.quote: A pull-down assay confirmed that both AAV9-X1.1 and CAP-Mac bind to AAVR's PKD2 domain and the full length extracellular domain of mouse LRP6 but not that of closely-related LRP5 (Supplementary Fig. 9a).
sources.supports: Negative labels for LRP5 and positive labels for AAVR-PKD2 used in the reference panel and negative-control checks.

sources.quote: we were able to locate the human IL3 binding site on the side of AAV9's threefold symmetry spike adjacent to the capsid's twofold symmetry valley and generate an integrative binding model.
sources.supports: Engagement geometry at the threefold spike is a measured, checkable observable for capsid–partner complexes.

sources.quote: This structure reveals that of the five Ig-like polycystic kidney disease (PKD) domains in AAVR, PKD2 binds directly to the spike region of the AAV2 capsid adjacent to the icosahedral three-fold axis.
sources.supports: Anchor geometry: AAVR-PKD2 engagement at the AAV2 threefold-adjacent spike, structure PDB 6IHB.

sources.quote: Several cryo-EM structures of AAV-AAVR complexes are published using constructs containing either two domains (PKD12) or all five PKD domains (PKD1-5) with similar results (Meyer et al., 2019; Zhang et al., 2019; Silveria et al., 2020; Xu et al., 2022).
sources.supports: Published depth is a handful of complexes (single digits), and the 4.5 Å contact cutoff for interface footprints.

sources.quote: We identify alkaline phosphatase (ALPL) as the primary receptor used by VCAP-102 to cross the BBB and demonstrate that direct binding of VCAP-102 to human ALPL can initiate receptor-mediated transcytosis in a cell barrier model.
sources.supports: ALPL in the receptor panel with a published binder (VCAP-102, ~20 nM by SPR) and AAV9 as the parent negative.

sources.quote: Ly6a expression resulted in a >50-fold increase in binding by each of the AAV-PHP.B capsids to HEK293T cells, but did not increase binding by AAV9 (Fig 3A).
sources.supports: Published bind/no-bind labels for PHP.eB versus AAV9 against LY6A.

sources.quote: We found that LY6A pulled down PHP.eB even more efficiently than PKD2 did. By contrast, LY6A did not detectably capture any AAV9 capsids, revealing significantly different receptor selectivity for AAV9 and PHP.eB.
sources.supports: Receptor selectivity labels and the distinct AAVR domain usage (AAV5 uses PKD1, AAV1/2/8 use PKD2).

sources.quote: ColabFold's 40−60-fold faster search and optimized model utilization enables prediction of close to 1,000 structures per day on a server with one graphics processing unit.
sources.supports: Feasibility of running hundreds of multimer predictions on single GPUs at the run counts the budget buys.

sources.quote: Prediction time for a structure of N residues is roughly (N/30)*(N/30) seconds for an Nvidia A40 GPU.
sources.supports: Proxy for AlphaFold-Multimer wall-clock per run used in the cost estimate (af2_h_per_run).
Proxy for MD throughput on one A100 (129.1 ns/day for a 170k-atom protein in water) used to size the 5-ns relaxations.
